title: Electricity Provider in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **If you never signed a contract, you pay the default tariff.** In Berlin that is Vattenfall's Grundversorgung: since **1 April 2026** it costs **37.93 cents per kWh plus €13.40 a month**.
**The base price hits small flats hardest.** €160.80 a year is due before any use, so a one-person flat on **1,200 kWh** pays **€616**, really **51.3 cents per kWh**.
**Start with your own kWh.** It is printed on your last annual bill as Verbrauch. Averages for a flat: **1,200** kWh for one person, **1,900** for two, **2,400** for three.
**Compare without the bonus first.** A new-customer bonus only lowers year one, and it is often paid only after **12 months of supply**.
**Switching is free and quick.** You can leave the default tariff at **two weeks' notice**, the new supplier cancels for you, and the technical switch takes **24 hours** on a working day.
**My move:** put your kWh and two or three offers into the tool, then pick the one that wins once the bonus is gone.
